title: Lil Tapz's Newest album "Up the space" Climbs Up The Music Charts 2022
htmlContent:
From Las Vegas Nevada comes Lil Tapz, a unique and talented artist who is making moves to better his career. Being an independent artist, he and his team do everything in-house, from the music production down to the promotion that gets the song to move; they take care of it all.

Lil Tapz released his album “Up In Space” not long ago and is using it as a stepping stone to make a big move in 2022. With the album receiving positive feedback and support revolving around popular songs off the album, Lil Tapz has built the momentum to take the next step in his journey. 

As he continues to build and create his career exactly how he wants it to be, look for Lil Tapz to only improve as an artist. He has unlimited potential, and there is no telling where this next project could lead, but it is only up from here.
